tagline: Corrugated production preparation. This interface reports only actual local/API responses.
integrationNotice: Cloud-backed extraction, conditions, predictions, optimization, evidence, job persistence, translation and photo classification are unavailable until their real integrations are configured. Agent traces, job creation, approval, stored job cards and feedback are also unavailable. No production values or sample orders are prefilled.
currentStage: Current stage: purchase-order input required. No order has been accepted, and no downstream stage can proceed.
orderDescription: Required input: an operator-supplied PDF. The endpoint validates the PDF, but extraction is unavailable until its genuine service is configured.
traceDescription: A genuine run and shared trace are required before showing tool activity.
traceUnavailable: Unavailable: orchestration and trace are not configured
analysisDescription: Requires an accepted order and genuine conditions, prediction, optimization, and evidence responses. These service ports are unavailable.
analysisUnavailable: Unavailable: production analysis services are not configured
approvalDescription: Approval requires a persisted job and the source-defined approval service; neither is available.
approvalUnavailable: Unavailable: job persistence and approval are not configured
printDescription: The local PDF renderer accepts a caller-supplied JobSheet only. It is not a substitute for an approved, stored production job card.
translationNote: Static translations cover ordinary interface labels only. Glossary-backed production text and live translation are unavailable.
statusDescription: Status comes from /api/status; it does not verify a live cloud connection.
riskRequestPayload: Validated order, conditions and machine settings JSON
evidenceRequestPayload: Order and conditions JSON for historical evidence
noConversion: No conversion requested. The converter does not update application data.
tracePanelDescription: Subscribe only with a run ID returned by genuine orchestration. Test traces are not production runs.
traceInitial: No genuine run is available to display.
traceDisconnected: Trace connection was interrupted. The browser may reconnect automatically.
selectPdf: Select a PDF file before submitting.
invalidJson: Enter a valid JSON object, then retry.
jsonObject: The request body must be a JSON object.
jobJson: Enter a valid JobSheet JSON object, then retry.
jobObject: The JobSheet must be a JSON object.
networkError: The local application could not be reached. Check that the server is running, then retry.
unreadable: The server returned an unreadable response.
unavailable: This capability is unavailable; no operation was completed.
validation: Validation failed. Check the listed fields.
requestFailed: The request failed. Internal diagnostic details are not displayed.
invalidAmount: Enter a finite amount before converting.
pdfRendered: PDF rendered from the supplied JobSheet only. No translation, persistence, or cloud upload occurred.
conversionUnavailable: Display conversion unavailable; original value is unchanged.
